title: Thai Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Thai-inspired lamb dish cooked in a tagine with aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: large, traditional clay pot with a conical lid

instructions: Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the tagine over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the tagine and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, honey, cinnamon, and ginger to the tagine.
Return the lamb to the tagine and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine with its conical lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
